newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduran GDP up 4.3 pct from Jan-June - cenbanker.
newsitem.headline: Honduran GDP up 4.3 pct from Jan-June - cenbanker.

text.p: Honduran gross domestic product (GDP) grew 4.3 percent in the first six months of 1997, auguring well for the government's year-end target of 4.5 percent, the head of the central bank said on Friday.
"We see a series of favorable signs that will enable us to reach at least 4.5 percent growth at the end of the year," Hugo Pino said a news conference.
He said GDP in the first two quarters was bolstered by foreign trade, with higher world coffee prices and strong banana sales playing key roles.
He expected growth to accelerate further in the second half of the year, saying interest rates would fall further because of abundant liquidity in the banking system.
International reserves as of Aug 7 were $461 million, up $250 million from the end of December, he said.
